title: DWARF real-node measurements — Amaru proof and Cardano parity
description: Persistent implementation tracker. Amaru and Cardano-node 11.1.2 are independently proven end to end through the deployed GUI. Mixed-node measurements have not started and remain outside this completed phase.

baseline.scope_boundary: Stop after independent Cardano-node proof; do not start mixed-node measurement comparison.

steps.title: Define reusable measurements independent of scenarios
steps.evidence: Measurement and Measurement Profile catalogs, optional non-gating lifecycle, exact compatibility, outcome-independent timing, correlation, reports, and portable evidence reuse the existing DWARF runner.

steps.title: Implement exact-version Amaru stock, external, resource, coverage, and patched taps
steps.evidence: Exact 10.11.20260912/b159172 source and image identity; stock JSON/OTLP normalization; real-process resources; workload/restart/sync taps; revision-locked patched boundaries and stock/patched calibration; compiler-coverage linkage.

steps.title: Expose measurements, profiles, run reports, and guidance in DWARF
steps.evidence: /operate/measurements, /operate/measurement-profiles, /learn/measurements, retained run report, searchable responsive table, report downloads, SARIF state, collector health, and portable bundle export are wired.

steps.title: Prove Amaru end to end through the deployed GUI
steps.evidence: Run 20260918T234213Z-64959688 passed at DWARF df255de7. It retained all 100 timed hostile attempts, 39 normalized real-node records, four header/BlockFetch/block-apply samples, six adopted blocks over 10.662s, real target resources, 11 finalized collectors, zero collector errors, exact target identity, and a clean downloadable bundle.

steps.title: Record Amaru claims and non-claims
steps.evidence: This proves collection and evidence plumbing, not a performance threshold or vulnerability. Twenty-one unavailable rows remain unavailable rather than zero. The system_start=0 synthetic slot-age value is retained but excluded from comparable propagation-latency claims. Five full example workflows are deferred unless needed for system proof.

steps.title: Audit exact Cardano-node 11.1.2 stock visibility and patch gaps
steps.evidence: Exact upstream source and pinned network, consensus, ledger, and Plutus dependencies were audited. Stock visibility and honest gaps are recorded for ChainSync, BlockFetch, TxSubmission2, KeepAlive, mempool, ChainDB, ledger, Plutus, epoch, restart/sync, resources, and coverage.

steps.title: Add Cardano measurements, profiles, target modes, and exact identity resolution
steps.evidence: Stock, external, resource, coverage, and patched definitions resolve only against exact Cardano-node 11.1.2 identities. The patched target is pinned by source, patch-set, executable, build-result, runtime-probe, and OCI digests.

steps.title: Implement Cardano stock telemetry, workload, sync, restart, and real-resource collectors
steps.evidence: Cardano stock trace normalization, workload accounting, sync/restart, and actual node-process/namespace resources are integrated. The loader-wrapped packaged process is resolved to the real cardano-node child and regression-tested.

steps.title: Register coverage and build only source-audited patched boundaries
steps.evidence: The existing production coverage target is revision-qualified. The additive patched target emits only audited protocol/decode and ledger/Plutus gaps and passed fresh-build/runtime qualification.

steps.title: Prove paired stock/patched observer overhead
steps.evidence: Identical 100-attempt stock and patched legs completed. Stock/patched handshake median: 164.5/159.0 us (-3.343%); p95: 248/249 us (+0.403%). Authority is limited to this common external metric.

steps.title: Run the representative Cardano-node scenario through the deployed GUI
steps.evidence: GUI run 20260919T032200Z-59f94558 passed. It retained 100 timed hostile attempts, accepted/rejected Plutus paths, 35 available and 13 honestly unavailable metric rows, 12 finalized collectors, zero collector errors, exact target provenance, and a clean portable bundle.

steps.title: Run full regression, browser, export, forbidden-file, and secret checks
steps.evidence: Portable bundle SHA-256 f8f278b3b64aaf872af3cb8d59e52c6a23b9df57c98797f8d82419d111555448 passed gzip and forbidden-file inspection. Full regression and final two-cycle browser review remain to be recorded.

steps.title: Report independent Amaru and Cardano status and stop before mixed
steps.evidence: Both independent workflows are proven. No mixed-node measurement implementation or run was started.
